subject.title: feat: inspect background tasks across web and mobile

question: Should operator-read clients be allowed to retrieve bounded background-task prompts through tasks.get?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes the gateway's disclosed data from task summaries to operator-authored task input, and repository evidence does not define whether that more sensitive content belongs within the existing read scope.

options.title: Keep operator-read access
options.body: Explicitly document the prompt-sensitivity contract and add authorization coverage proving that only the intended operator scope can call tasks.get.

options.title: Require a stronger scope
options.body: Gate prompt-bearing task details behind a stronger administrative permission while retaining summary-only access for ordinary operator-read clients.

options.title: Defer prompt disclosure
options.body: Land grouping and outcome improvements without returning prompts until the authorization boundary has a separately approved design.

recommendation.title: Keep operator-read access
recommendation.body: Explicitly document the prompt-sensitivity contract and add authorization coverage proving that only the intended operator scope can call tasks.get.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway protocol and all three user-facing clients, matching his recent cross-client repository history.
